summary: - **[AIDASoft/DD4hep#1681](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep/pull/1681)**: Removed the CSG-based ASSIMP CAD exporter from DDCAD because ROOT made `RCsg`/`CsgOps.h` private. This is a user-visible loss of functionality (CAD export path is broken until a replacement lands in [#1682](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep/pull/1682)) — downstream users relying on CAD export should be aware.

- **[AIDASoft/DD4hep#1663](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep/pull/1663)**: Fixed `Geant4Output2EDM4hep`, `Geant4Output2LCIO`, and `Geant4Output2ROOT` so that in multi-threaded mode the ingested run parameters and file parameters correctly end up in the output (fixes #1660), and corrected locking of the endRun action. This is an important correctness fix for anyone running ddsim in MT mode.

- **[AIDASoft/DD4hep#1666](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep/pull/1666)**: Added a new `kUpstreamTrapezoid` mask type in `Mask_o1_v01_geo.cpp` to handle non-cylindrically-symmetric Synchrotron Radiation Masks needed for the FCC MDI geometry (paired with k4geo #648). Enables more realistic FCC MDI modelling.

- **[key4hep/k4geo#658](https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo/pull/658)**: Introduced `MuSIC_v3`, a new muon-collider detector geometry with instrumented nozzles (three silicon Forward Tracker disks), reduced/renumbered vertex barrel and endcap layers, and removal of the yoke iron (HCAL barrel now used as flux return). A significant physics-capable geometry update for muon-collider studies.

- **[AIDASoft/DD4hep#1680](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep/pull/1680)**: Replaced deprecated `RVersion.h` includes with `ROOT/RVersion.hxx` to be forward-compatible with ROOT master. Prevents build warnings/errors as ROOT proceeds with the deprecation.

- **[key4hep/EDM4hep#524](https://github.com/key4hep/EDM4hep/pull/524)**: Hides the deprecated `Track::getTrackState(int32_t)` overload from Cling/cppyy, since cppyy was selecting the wrong overload. Fixes a subtle Python-side correctness issue (#523) for users accessing track states via PyROOT.

- **[key4hep/k4GaudiPandora#54](https://github.com/key4hep/k4GaudiPandora/pull/54)**: Fixes PFO comparison to work with the current EDM4hep API (after EDM4hep#520). Restores correct behavior of Pandora PFA reconstruction validation against the latest EDM4hep.

- **[key4hep/k4ActsTracking#98](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/98)**: Adapts to updated ACTS propagator and grid-bin-finder APIs after acts-project/acts#6004. Note: users building k4ActsTracking against older tagged ACTS releases will need to update — downstream CI workflows pinned to older ACTS versions will fail until updated.

- **[key4hep/k4ActsTracking#104](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/104)**: Adds support for the new `TrackingGeometryMaterial` struct (acts-project/acts#6123) while keeping backward compatibility with the previous pair-based API. Ensures continued functioning across ACTS versions.

- **[key4hep/k4ActsTracking#102](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/102)**: Replaces deprecated ACTS material-binning APIs with `AxisSpec` for blueprint material binning, tracking upstream ACTS changes.

- **[key4hep/k4FWCore#431](https://github.com/key4hep/k4FWCore/pull/431)**: Adds `--evt-max` as a k4run alias for `ApplicationMgr.EvtMax`, making it clearer how to set the Gaudi event limit from the command line. Small usability improvement for all Key4hep users.

- **[key4hep/k4ActsTracking#97](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/97)**: Makes `--compactFile` a required argument in `CLD_CKFTracking.py`, `runGNNTrackFinding.py`, and `test_visualize_acts_geo.py`, replacing a cryptic Gaudi `TypeError` with a clear argparse error. Improves usability for tracking workflows.

- **[hep-fcc/k4RecCalorimeter#284](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/k4RecCalorimeter/pull/284)**: Moves the Boost `timer` / `unit_test_framework` `find_package` calls inside the `BUILD_TESTING` block so that `-DBUILD_TESTING=OFF` builds no longer require these Boost components. Helpful for downstream packagers with slimmer Boost builds.

- **[hep-fcc/FCC-config#386](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCC-config/pull/386)**: Adds `--addTruthTracks`/`--runTrkValidation` support to the IDEA digitization/reconstruction chain and exposes the switch through the IDEA and ALLEGRO ctests. Enables consistent tracking validation across FCC-ee detector concepts.

- **[hep-fcc/root2gltf#15](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/root2gltf/pull/15)**: Overhauls the ROOT-to-glTF conversion: shrinks overlapping child volumes to avoid z-fighting, reduces `numFaces` to 1000, increases transparency to 100%, and adds various fixes to input/output handling. Materially improves the visual quality of 3D detector displays for FCC geometries (ALLEGRO, CLD, IDEA).

- **[key4hep/k4geo#662](https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo/pull/662)**: Maps detector volumes to their closest predefined ROOT colors, addressing part of the visualization consistency issue (#616). Improves the appearance of detector displays derived from k4geo.
